about: The hub's New Game state (world_mode: hub; docs/ap/seed_format.md 'Hub', docs/handoff/hub.md D1): the late proof's state (the user's save at the Final Save Point, tools/ap_late_proof.py build_state) with what belongs to one player's game reset. Written by tools/ap_hub_state.py; the APWorld copies `hub` into the seed's hub block (start and the Synard words per hub_start).
step_reason: 4000, the save's step (after Cyril, at the Final Save Point). Every map was swept at chapter 60 step 4000 by the late proof, and the goal needs it: the Final Save Point floor's way to the corridor (671 -> 684) and the final boss's scene (685: chapter 60 step 4000, which stores 5000). Fienal's three pairs (D10) play their own scenes at their steps (657 Ruprecht & Nicolus at 1000, 669 Vesper & Decus at 2000, 674 Cyril at 3000) inside their chambers' story views, so the hub never needs a lower step; L'Aqua's chapter-60 departure scene (686, step 0 -> 1000) stays silent. With the views on, Fienal's rooms show their pre-pair states until each pair is beaten, so Fienal is proven again (the hub proof).

story.why: the story is passed: chapter 60 with every scene's flags as the user's game left them, which the late proof swept (610 maps); flag 1 comes per game

gift_guard.why: a location: every gift waits (the late proof's done flags)

boss_guard.why: every boss waits: a chamber's guard at the value that leaves its scene armed, its scene's own 'won' flag clear, the Fields' 162-165 clear (no Field done), the Cave of Trials' guards clear (late proof), the optional bosses' done flags clear (their quest state is kept)

pa.why: Private Action results belong to the user's party (relationship and PA-chain conditions); a new game has none. Relationship values are config data (+0x58 / +0xe8), New Game's

ending.why: the ending flow, the special ending pairs and Limiter Off (the limiter-off goals need it clear)

other.why: one-time talks, puzzle / door state and quest flags without a story test: as the late proof proved them; key items kept except those a hub chamber's scene gives

start_random: hub_start random: the APWorld picks one of `starts` (every town of both worlds, the user's D9) and writes it as hub.start with its `globals` (the start's Synard words, which the port writes after hub.globals); fun_city / arlia pick those two.
